blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current world models for explicit world simulation typically follow two distinct pathways: (1) video generative models (e.g., Sora), which simulate realistic appearances but fail to preserve 3D consistency; and (2) 3D generative models (e.g., Marble), which generate geometrically consistent scenes but often yield static, less realistic observations. We present AEON, a unified framework that bridges video-based and 3D-based world models and combines the benefits of both. The key insight of AEON lies in a generative model that operates within the text- or image-conditioned video latent space while producing renderable 4D graphics primitives---specifically, 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS)---as the explicit world representation. We train a 4D reconstruction model to predict both 4DGS and camera poses from monocular videos, serving as our initialized 4D decoder. Furthermore, we design a domain adapter that translates generative video latents into reconstructive 4D latents through a distillation process on the video VAE. AEON naturally supports video-based world modeling by rendering 4DGS at predicted camera trajectories, and constructs a persistent 4D environment with scene dynamics for realistic world simulation. Consequently, AEON empowers a diverse range of world modeling applications and achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. Project Page: https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON
blocks.zh: 目前的世界显性模拟模型一般遵循两种不同的路径:(1)视频基因模型(例如Sora),它模拟现实的外观,但未能保持3D的一致性;(2)3D基因模型(例如Marble),它产生几何一致性的场景,但往往产生静止的,不太现实的观测结果. 我们提出AEON,一个连接基于视频和基于3D的世界模型并结合两者利益的统一框架. AEON的关键洞察力在于一种基因模型,在文本或图像条件的视频潜在空间内运作,同时产生可渲染的4D图形原始——特指4D高斯镀(4DGS)——作为明确的世界代表. 我们训练一个4D重建模型 来预测4DGS和相机的姿势 从单视视频, 作为我们初始化的4D解码器。 此外,我们设计了一个域适配器,通过视频VAE上的蒸馏过程,将基因视频潜伏转化为重建的4D潜伏. AEON通过在预测的相机轨迹上渲染4DGS,自然支持基于视频的世界建模,并构建具有场景动态的持久4D环境,用于现实的世界模拟. 因此,AEON赋予了各种各样的世界模型应用能力,并在标准基准上取得了最先进的业绩。 项目网页:https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World modeling has rapidly advanced to the forefront of AI research, driven by its immense potential in embodied AI, autonomous driving, and game design. Despite this progress, there remains a lack of consensus on the optimal representation for explicit world simulation, leaving the field divided between two dominant paradigms: video-based [ 26 , 38 ] and 3D-based world models [ 45 , 14 ] . As highlighted in Table 1 , these approaches possess orthogonal strengths and suffer from fundamental, paradigm-specific bottlenecks. Consequently, a more powerful and unified representation is imperative to achieve comprehensive world modeling.
blocks.zh: 世界建模已经迅速发展到AI研究的前沿,其驱动力在于其体现在AI,自主驱动和游戏设计中的巨大潜力. 尽管取得了这些进展,但在明确世界模拟的最佳表现方面仍然缺乏共识,使得这个领域被分为两个主导范式:基于视频的[26,38]和基于3D的世界模型[45,14]. 如表1所示,这些办法具有正统优势,并有根本的、具体范式的瓶颈。 因此,更强大和统一的代表性是实现全面的世界模式化的必要条件。

blocks.en: We begin by asking a fundamental question: What constitutes a good world model? To train robots to understand physical laws and perceive scenes, a world model should exhibit the following properties: (1) generating realistic appearances that align with real-world domains; (2) modeling dynamic scene evolution (e.g., fire, waves) and moving objects; (3) maintaining 3D consistent environments free from geometric ambiguity; (4) ensuring scene persistence for continuous and repeatable simulation; and (5) supporting real-time exploration to facilitate efficient interaction. We argue that a representation unifying video- and 3D-based world models, thereby benefiting from their complementary strengths, is the key to achieving such an ideal world model.
blocks.zh: 我们首先提出一个基本问题: 什么是好世界模式? 为了训练机器人了解物理定律和感知场景,一个世界模型应该表现出以下属性:(1)产生符合现实世界域的现实外观;(2)模拟动态场景演化(如火,波)和移动物体;(3)保持3D一致的环境,没有几何模糊;(4)确保场景持续进行连续和可重复的模拟;(5)支持实时探索,以促进高效的相互作用. 我们主张,将基于视频和3D的世界模式统一起来,从而受益于其互补优势,是实现这种理想的世界模式的关键。

blocks.en: We present AEON, a generative world model that introduces 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) [ 41 , 53 ] as its foundational representation, unifying video and 3D models to benefit from both paradigms. 4DGS represents scenes as a set of explicit graphics primitives localized in spatial geometry, and models scene dynamics through the velocity-driven movement and time-varying visibility of these primitives. Consequently, a learned 4DGS representation provides two independent yet crucial capabilities: it models world appearances through direct rendering along user-defined camera trajectories, and it establishes a persistent 4D environment that supports highly controllable 3D simulations. Additionally, it enables explicit modeling of world geometry and physical states, including depth, normals, motion, and optical flow.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍AEON,一种基因世界模型,引入4D高斯镀板(4DGS)[41,53]作为其基础代表,统一视频和3D模型,从两个范式中受益. 4DGS代表场景是一组在空间几何中局部化的显性图形原始体,模型场景动态通过这些原始体的速度驱动运动和时间变化的能见度. 因此,一个学习的4DGS表示提供了两种独立而又关键的能力:它通过沿用户定义的相机轨迹直接渲染来模拟世界的外观,它建立了支持高度可控的3D模拟的持久4D环境. 此外,它还能够对世界几何学和物理状态,包括深度、常态、运动和光学流动,进行明确的建模。

blocks.en: Despite the comprehensive capabilities inherent to the 4DGS representation, most existing approaches restrict its application to reconstruction tasks, and generating a persistent 4DGS world directly from text or image conditions remains largely unexplored. In AEON, we propose a novel framework that integrates the generative latent space of a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) [ 38 , 29 ] with the reconstructive latent space of a 4D reconstruction model. Specifically, we train a 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model (4DRM) to jointly predict 4DGS attributes and camera poses from monocular videos. By utilizing a large-scale annotated 4D video dataset and pretrained geometric priors from MapAnything [ 17 ] , a scalable geometry model, the 4DRM develops robust reconstructive capabilities to recover world geometry and dynamics. A primary challenge, however, is the significant domain gap between the video and 4DRM latent spaces. We address this by introducing a domain adapter that seamlessly bridges the two. Finally, we employ a multi-stage training pipeline that optimizes the adapter and fine-tunes the reconstruction model through end-to-end distillation from the video model, supervised by video VAE-decoded outputs.
blocks.zh: 尽管4DGS代表制具有内在的综合能力,但大多数现有方法都将其应用限制在重建任务上,直接从文字或图像条件产生一个持久的4DGS世界,但基本上仍未加以探讨。 在AEON中,我们提出了一个新颖的框架,将预先训练过的视频“传播变形器”[38,29]的基因潜在空间与4D重建模型的重建潜在空间结合起来。 具体地说,我们训练一种4D高斯重建模型(4DRM)来联合预测4DGS属性和单视视频的相机姿势. 4DRM通过使用大型附加说明的4D视频数据集和来自MapAnything [17]的预先训练的几何前缀,可缩放几何模型,发展了强大的重建能力,以恢复世界几何和动态. 然而,一个主要挑战是视频和4DRM潜在空间之间的重大域间差距。 我们通过引入一个无缝连接两者的域适配器来解决这个问题。 最后,我们采用了多阶段培训管道,通过视频模型的端到端蒸馏,通过视频VAE解码输出来优化适配器,并对重建模型进行微调.

blocks.en: Consequently, AEON unlocks an extensive array of world modeling applications, including text/image/video-to-4DGS generation, 3D world generation, robotics simulation, physical state estimation (e.g., depth, normals, and optical flow), scene editing, and novel view and timestep synthesis.
blocks.zh: 因此,AEON解锁了大量的世界建模应用,包括文本/图像/视频到4DGS生成,3D世界生成,机器人模拟,物理状态估计(如深度,常态和光学流),场景编辑,以及新颖的视图和时序合成.

blocks.en: Our main contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce AEON, a unified world modeling framework that represents worlds as explicit 4D Gaussians, effectively bridging video-based and 3D-based models to benefit from their complementary strengths. • We propose a novel methodology that integrates the generative latent space of a pretrained video DiT with the reconstructive latent space of a 4D Gaussian reconstruction model. To achieve this, we train a specialized domain adapter through an end-to-end distillation of the video model. • AEON demonstrates comprehensive versatility, natively supporting a diverse spectrum of world modeling tasks, and establishes new state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们引入了AEON这个统一的世界模型框架,它代表世界是明确的4D Gaussians,有效地连接基于视频和基于3D的模型,以得益于它们的互补优势. —— 我们提出一种新颖的方法,将预先训练的视频DiT的基因潜伏空间与4D高斯重建模型的重建潜伏空间结合起来。 为了实现这一目标,我们通过视频模型的端到端蒸馏来训练一个专门的域名适配器. • AEON显示出全面的多功能性,在本土上支持各种不同的世界建模任务,并在标准基准上确立最新成果。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video and 3D World Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频和三维世界模式

blocks.en: World modeling aims to generate explorable and realistic environments from conditional inputs (e.g., text or images), serving as a foundation for embodied AI and autonomous systems. Current paradigms primarily rely on video-based [ 26 , 11 , 32 , 19 , 52 , 38 ] or 3D-based [ 45 , 35 , 51 , 14 , 33 , 3 , 10 ] approaches. Within the video-centric domain, JEPA-style methods [ 2 , 1 ] excel at forecasting future latent states but lack explicit visual synthesis. Conversely, video world models [ 26 , 38 , 19 ] and their action-conditioned variants [ 5 , 44 , 36 , 37 ] can synthesize photorealistic frames, yet they struggle with 3D consistency and incur heavy computational costs due to massive per-frame token generation.
blocks.zh: 世界建模旨在从有条件的投入(如文本或图像)中创造可探索和现实的环境,作为体现的AI和自主系统的基础. 目前的模式主要依靠基于视频的[26,11,32,19,52,38]或基于3D的[45,35,51,14,33,3,10]方法. 在以视频为中心的领域,JEPA风格的方法[2,1]擅长预测未来潜在的状态,但缺乏明显的视觉合成. 反之,视频世界模型[26,38,19]及其动作条件的变体[5,44,36,37]可以合成光现实化帧,然而它们却与3D一致性相抗衡,并且由于每个帧的符号生成量巨大而产生沉重的计算成本.

blocks.en: Alternatively, 3D world models [ 45 , 14 ] construct explicit environments for simulation. Recent works have explored panoramic generation [ 35 , 51 ] , progressive expansion [ 14 ] , or leveraging video priors [ 3 ] . However, these methods typically employ static representations such as 3DGS [ 18 ] or meshes, precluding the modeling of world dynamics and limiting their ability to scale on dynamic internet video datasets. The same holds for 3D generation and reconstruction more broadly, which mostly build on static Gaussians [ 62 , 59 , 58 , 56 , 47 ] or distance fields [ 63 , 64 , 25 , 24 ] . To bridge this gap, we propose AEON, a framework that generates renderable 4D Gaussian Splatting [ 53 , 41 ] (4DGS) primitives as an explicit world representation. AEON effectively unifies the strengths of both paradigms, achieving dynamic modeling with 3D consistency while overcoming their respective limitations.
blocks.zh: 或者,三维世界模型[45,14]构建明晰的模拟环境. 近期的作品探索了全景生成[35,51],渐进扩展[14],或利用视频前传. [3]. 然而,这些方法通常采用3DGS[18]或meshes等静态表达方式,排除了世界动态的模型化,限制了它们在动态互联网视频数据集上的规模化能力. 3D生成和重建的范围也比较广泛,它们大多建立在静止的高斯人[62,59,58,56,47]或距离场[63,64,25,24]的基础上. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议采用AEON这一框架,将4D Gaussian Splateting[53,41](4DGS)原始人产生成明显的世界代表性. AEON有效统一了两种范式的优点,在克服各自局限的同时,实现了3D一致性的动态模型化.

blocks.en: 2.2 4D Gaussian Splatting from Videos
blocks.zh: 2.2 来自视频的4D高斯滑板

blocks.en: 4D Gaussian Splatting [ 53 , 41 ] advances the success of 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 18 ] for modeling scene dynamics. 4DGS learns from multi-view videos to predict Gaussian primitives with explicit temporal attributes such as lifespan, velocity, and time-varying opacity, allowing Gaussians to appear, move, and vanish independently. However, predicting 4DGS from monocular videos remains significantly more challenging due to limited observational data. While optimization-based methods [ 39 , 20 , 34 ] can achieve faithful visual appearances, they require lengthy fitting processes and struggle to generalize or scale. More recently, feed-forward frameworks [ 31 , 48 , 50 , 22 , 60 ] have been proposed for fast and scalable video-to-4DGS reconstruction, including bullet-time reconstruction at arbitrary timestamps [ 21 ] and online reconstruction from uncalibrated video streams [ 46 ] . Some of these works predict deformable 3DGS [ 22 , 28 ] as their foundational representation, which often falls short when modeling complex and diverse dynamics. Related feed-forward models also recover dynamic geometry and camera poses from monocular videos [ 8 ] . All of these methods reconstruct scenes from observed videos. Native 4DGS generation has also been explored for animated objects [ 57 ] . Closer to our setting, Diff4Splat [ 28 ] and Lyra [ 3 ] build Gaussian scenes on top of video diffusion priors, but both require a camera trajectory as input and represent dynamics with deformable 3DGS and per-frame 3DGS, respectively. AEON differs in both respects: it generates a world from a text prompt or a single image without camera input, and it represents the world as one persistent set of 4D primitives, each with its own reference time, duration, and velocity, so that content can appear, move, and vanish independently and can be rendered at any continuous timestep.
blocks.zh: 4D Gaussian Splating [53, 41] 推进3D Gaussian Splating [18] 成功建模场景动态. 4DGS从多景视频中学习来预测高斯原始人具有明确的时间属性,如寿命,速度,以及时间变化不透明,使得高斯人能够独立出现,移动,消失. 然而,由于观测数据有限,从单视视频中预测4DGS仍然具有更大的挑战性. 虽然基于优化的方法[39,20,34]可以实现忠实的视觉外观,但是它们需要漫长的适配过程和斗争来概括或规模化. 最近,为快速和可扩展的视频至4DGS的重建,包括任意时间戳的子弹时间重建[21]和来自未校准的视频流的在线重建[46],提出了信息转发框架[31、48、50、22、60]。 其中一些作品预测可变形的3DGS[22,28]是它们的基础代表,在模拟复杂多样的动态时往往会有所不足. 相关的Feed-forward模型也从单视视频中恢复动态几何和相机姿势[8]. 所有这些方法都从被观察的视频中重建场景. 原生4DGS生成也被探索到动画对象[57]. 离我们的设定更近,Diff4Splate [28] 和Lyra [3] 将高斯的场景建在视频传播的前身之上,但两者都需要一个相机轨迹作为输入,并分别以可变形的3DGS和每帧3DGS代表动态. AEON在两个方面都有不同:它从一个文本即时或一个单一的图像中生成一个没有相机输入的世界,它代表着世界是一个由4D原始物组成的持久集,每个集都有自己的参考时间,持续时间和速度,这样内容就可以独立出现,移动,消失,并且可以在任何连续的时间内被制成.

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We present AEON, a generative world model that operates within the latent space of a pretrained video diffusion model while producing explicit 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) as the world representation. Given a text prompt or conditioning image, our goal is to generate a set of 4D Gaussians encoding both appearance and dynamics, enabling photorealistic rendering and persistent 3D simulation. The overview of AEON is shown in Fig. 2 . We begin by introducing the 4DGS representation in Sec. 3.1 , which models dynamic scenes through velocity-driven motion and time-varying visibility. In Sec. 3.2 , we present the 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model, whose four task-specific heads jointly predict depth, Gaussian appearance, dynamic evolution, and camera poses from monocular videos. We then describe our domain adapter in Sec. 3.3 , which bridges the generative video latent space and the reconstructive 4D latent space through distillation. Finally, Sec. 3.4 details our multi-stage training strategy that optimizes the full pipeline end-to-end.
blocks.zh: 我们提出AEON,一种基因世界模型,在预先训练的视频传播模型的潜在空间内运作,同时产生明确的4D高斯电镀(4DGS)作为世界代表. 鉴于文本即时或调制图像,我们的目标是生成一组4D 高斯人编码,将外观和动态都编码,从而能够进行光现实化渲染和持续的3D模拟. AEON的概况见图2。 我们首先在第3.1节中引入了4DGS代表,它通过速度驱动的运动和时间变化的能见度来模拟动态场景. 在第3.2章中,我们介绍了4D高斯重建模型,其四个任务特定的头共同预测深度,高斯的外观,动态进化,以及单视视频的相机姿势. 然后我们在3.3中描述我们的域适配器,它通过蒸馏来连接基因影像潜伏空间和重建的4D潜伏空间. 最后,第3.4条详述了我们优化整个管道端到端的多阶段培训战略。

blocks.en: 3.1 4D Gaussian Splatting as the World Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 4D 高斯滑板作为世界代表

blocks.en: An ideal world model should jointly capture realistic appearances, scene dynamics, and 3D-consistent geometry within a persistent and efficiently renderable representation. To this end, AEON adopts 4D Gaussian primitives [ 41 , 53 , 60 ] as its foundational scene representation, where each primitive simultaneously encodes geometry, appearance, and temporal evolution. Formally, a single primitive g i g_{i} is characterized by the following parameter set g i = { 𝐱 i , 𝐬 i , 𝐫 i , o i , 𝐜 i , t i , l i , 𝐯 i , 𝝎 i } . g_{i}=\{\mathbf{x}_{i},\mathbf{s}_{i},\mathbf{r}_{i},o_{i},\mathbf{c}_{i},t_{i},l_{i},\mathbf{v}_{i},\boldsymbol{\omega}_{i}\}. (1) Specifically, 𝐱 i ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{x}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} denotes the spatial center, 𝐬 i ∈ ℝ 2 \mathbf{s}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{2} parameterizes anisotropic scaling along the principal axes, and 𝐫 i ∈ ℝ 4 \mathbf{r}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{4} encodes the orientation as a unit quaternion. The base opacity o i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] o_{i}\in[0,1] together with the color 𝐜 i ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{c}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} jointly determine the visual appearance of each primitive.

blocks.en: 3.2 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model
blocks.zh: 3.2 4D 高斯重建模式

blocks.en: While 4DGS offers an ideal world representation, directly generating 4D Gaussians from diverse conditions is highly challenging without proper guidance and geometric initialization. To address this, we first train a 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model (4DRM) as a foundation, focusing on the more tractable task of world recovery from monocular videos. In a single feed-forward pass, 4DRM uses four task-specific heads to jointly predict depth, camera poses, and 4D Gaussian attributes of appearance and evolution. The model is trained end-to-end via differentiable rendering. Once trained, 4DRM facilitates AEON’s generative world modeling in two ways: (1) it provides a reconstructive foundation to initialize the student 4DRM that recovers the world from video latents, and (2) it acts as a teacher model, guiding the student to acquire 4D Gaussian modeling capabilities through distillation.
blocks.zh: 虽然4DGS提供了理想的世界代表性,但是在没有适当的指导和几何初始化的情况下,直接从各种条件下产生4D高斯人是非常具有挑战性的. 为了解决这个问题,我们首先培训一种4D高斯重建模型(4DRM)作为基础,专注于世界从单视视频中复苏的更可携带的任务. 在单一的Feed-forward pass中,4DRM使用四个任务特定头来联合预测深度,相机姿势,以及外观和进化的4D高斯属性. 该模型通过不同的渲染来训练端到端. 4DRM在经过培训后,以两种方式为AEON的基因世界建模提供了便利:(1)它为从视频潜伏中恢复世界的学生4DRM的初始化提供了重建基础;(2)它起到教师模型的作用,指导学生通过蒸馏获得4D高斯建模能力.

blocks.en: Given an input video V = { I t } t = 1 T V=\{I_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} of T T frames, we extract per-frame dense features 𝐅 t ∈ ℝ H / p × W / p × D \mathbf{F}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H/p\times W/p\times D} using a pretrained DINOv2 encoder [ 27 ] . To inject temporal identity, we add a sinusoidal positional embedding of the timestep index t t to each spatial feature map. The resulting per-frame tokens are concatenated across all frames and processed by a transformer backbone of L L layers that alternate between intra-frame and cross-frame self-attention, balancing computational efficiency with long-range temporal modeling. The output features 𝐅 S ∈ ℝ T ​ H ​ W / p 2 × D \mathbf{F}^{S}\in\mathbb{R}^{THW/p^{2}\times D} encode holistic spatio-temporal context for subsequent decoding. We initialize 4DRM from the pretrained weights of MapAnything [ 17 ] , a feed-forward metric 3D reconstruction model.

blocks.en: We decode the shared spatio-temporal representation 𝐅 t S \mathbf{F}^{S}_{t} through four task-specific heads, each responsible for a complementary component of the 4DGS world. The Depth Head predicts dense per-frame depth maps 𝐃 t ∈ ℝ H × W \mathbf{D}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W} , while the Camera Head regresses the intrinsics 𝐊 t \mathbf{K}_{t} together with per-frame rotations 𝐑 t \mathbf{R}_{t} (unit quaternions) and translations 𝐭 t \mathbf{t}_{t} . The predicted depths are unprojected via 𝐊 t \mathbf{K}_{t} into the Gaussian centers 𝐱 i \mathbf{x}_{i} , anchoring all downstream predictions in a metrically grounded 3D space. Conditioned on these centers, the Gaussian Head predicts the appearance attributes { 𝐬 i , 𝐫 i , o i , 𝐜 i } \{\mathbf{s}_{i},\mathbf{r}_{i},o_{i},\mathbf{c}_{i}\} (scale, orientation, opacity, and color), and the Evolution Head predicts the dynamic attributes { t i , l i , 𝐯 i , 𝝎 i } \{t_{i},l_{i},\mathbf{v}_{i},\boldsymbol{\omega}_{i}\} (temporal reference, duration, and linear and angular velocities) that govern how each primitive moves and fades over time. This decomposition lets the Gaussian and Evolution Heads focus exclusively on appearance and dynamics, while the Camera Head’s joint pose estimation enables 4DRM to operate directly on raw monocular videos, removing the dependency on pre-estimated poses or external Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipelines required by prior work [ 48 , 22 ] . As a result, 4DRM recovers a complete dynamic world state from a single monocular video and establishes a robust reconstructive latent space for the subsequent generative integration.

blocks.en: 3.3 Generative World Modeling
blocks.zh: 3.3 基因世界建模

blocks.en: AEON is designed to generate persistent and explorable 4D worlds from diverse conditions, such as text prompts and images. The complete pipeline is illustrated in the lower portion of Fig. 2 . Given a condition (e.g., a text prompt), we leverage a pretrained video diffusion model (e.g., Wan 2.2) as the generative foundation to produce a video latent, z video z_{\mathrm{video}} . Given that z video z_{\mathrm{video}} encapsulates profound world-modeling priors capable of decoding into realistic, high-quality videos, we aim to unlock its full potential by recovering an explicit and persistent 4DGS world. We introduce a Domain Adapter that performs latent translation, mapping the generative video latent z video z_{\mathrm{video}} to a reconstructive 4D latent z 4 ​ D z_{\mathrm{4D}} . A learnable student 4DRM then utilizes z 4 ​ D z_{\mathrm{4D}} to explicitly recover the 4DGS world. A simpler alternative would decode z video z_{\mathrm{video}} into frames with the VAE and pass them to the Stage-1 4DRM. We avoid this cascade because the 4DRM is trained on real videos, whereas decoded generations carry VAE and generation artifacts outside that distribution, so decoding errors would compound with reconstruction errors.
blocks.zh: AEON旨在从文本提示和图像等各种条件产生持久和可扩展的4D世界. 整个管道在图2的下半部分被描绘出来。 鉴于一个条件(例如文字提示),我们利用一个经过事先训练的视频传播模型(例如Wan 2.2)作为基因基础来制作一个视频潜伏,z的视频 z mathrm{video}。 z的视频 z mathrm{video} 封装了深刻的世界模范前科, 能够解码成现实、高质量的视频, 我们引入了一个执行潜伏翻译的域名适配器,将基因视频潜伏的z视频 z matherm{video}映射到重建的4D潜伏的z 4 D z matherm{4D} 一个可以学习的学生 4DRM 然后利用 z 4 D z mathrm{4D}} 明确恢复 4DGS 世界. 一个更简单的替代品可以将z的视频z_{\mathrm{video}}与VAE一起解码成帧,并传递到Stage-1 4DRM. 我们避免这种级联,因为4DRM在真实的视频上受过训练,而解码的世代则携带VAE和世代的文物在发行范围之外,因此解码错误会与重建错误相加.

blocks.en: A primary challenge in connecting the video generative model to the 4D reconstruction model is the significant domain gap between their latent representations. The video latent is optimized for generative denoising, while the 4DRM consumes DINOv2 [ 27 ] tokens that are trained for geometric and semantic understanding. These two feature spaces therefore occupy fundamentally different distributions. Naively replacing the DINOv2 patch embedding with a randomly initialized projection would forfeit the geometric prior carried by the pretrained backbone and force the student 4DRM to relearn its feature distribution from scratch. To avoid this, we introduce a learnable domain adapter that bridges the two latent spaces while preserving the geometric capabilities of the pretrained 4DRM backbone layers.
blocks.zh: 将视频基因模型与4D重建模型连接起来的主要挑战是其潜在表达之间的重大域间差距。 视频潜伏被优化为基因解读,而4DRM消耗了DINOv2[27]符号,这些符号经过了几何和语义理解的训练. 因此这两个特征空间占据了根本不同的分布. 以随机初始化投影取代DINOv2补丁将丧失预先训练过的骨干所携带的几何学,迫使学生4DRM从头开始重新学习其特征分布. 为了避免这种情况,我们引入了一个可学习的域适配器,在连接两个潜在空间的同时,保留预先训练的4DRM主干层的几何能力.

blocks.en: We implement the domain adapter as a dual-path architecture that couples a linearly initialized convolutional branch with an expressive Perceiver Bridge. To establish a robust baseline, we first solve a closed-form ridge regression to map the video latents to the target DINOv2 activations at each candidate insertion depth ℓ \ell . This linear mapping already recovers a coarse alignment, which makes it a good initialization, although on its own it falls well short of the full adapter (Sec. 4.4 ). Motivated by this, our dual-path design employs a linear branch to provide a stable foundation, while an expressive residual branch captures complex nonlinear transformations. Specifically, the linear branch 𝕃 \mathbb{L} is instantiated as a strided 3D convolution initialized with the closed-form ridge solution. The residual branch ℕ \mathbb{N} comprises a Perceiver Bridge module, detailed below. A learnable scalar gate γ \gamma fuses the two branches as: Z = 𝕃 ⁡ ( z video ) + γ ⋅ ℕ ⁡ ( z video ) , Z=\mathbb{L}(z_{\mathrm{video}})+\gamma\cdot\mathbb{N}(z_{\mathrm{video}}), (2) where γ \gamma is initialized to zero. Consequently, the adapter’s optimization begins entirely from the stable linear solution and progressively incorporates the nonlinear residual branch as γ \gamma updates via gradient descent, ensuring stable optimization from the outset.
blocks.zh: 我们把域位适配器作为双向结构, 将线性初始化的演化分支与表达式的Perceiver桥结合。 为了建立坚固的基线,我们首先解决封闭式山脊回归问题,将视频潜伏到目标DINOv2激活时的每个候选插入深度l\ell。 这种线性映射已经恢复了粗细的对齐,这使得它成为一个很好的初始化,虽然它本身远远低于完全适配器(Sec 4.4.4. 以此为动力,我们的双线道设计采用了线性分支来提供稳定的基础,而表现性的剩余分支则捕捉复杂的非线性转化. 具体地说,线性分支L\mathbb{L}被即时化,作为与封闭式脊溶液一起初始化的三维旋. 剩余分支 N\ mathbb{N} 包含一个 Perceiver 桥模块, 详情如下 。 可学习的scalar gate γ\gamma 将两分支的引信分别定为: Z = L → (z 视频) + γ N → (z 视频) , Z → mathbb{L}(z _{\ mathrm{video}}) → gamma\cdot\ mathbb{ N}(z _{\ mathrm{video}}) , (2)其中γ\gamma初始化为零. 因此,适配器的优化完全从稳定的线性溶液开始,并逐渐将非线性残余分支作为γ\gamma通过梯度下降更新,确保从一开始的稳定优化。

blocks.en: Implementing the residual branch with standard convolutions inherently dilutes fine-grained geometric information due to their restricted local receptive fields. Instead, we design a highly expressive Perceiver [ 15 ] Bridge module that leverages a learned token-to-token retrieval with a global receptive field. The video latent is first projected into the target feature dimension by a spatio-temporal Conv3D. An asymmetric temporal upsampler then restores the original temporal resolution by bypassing the independently encoded first frame and applying sub-pixel shuffle to the remaining compressed tokens so that the output length matches the original video exactly. The upsampled tokens are passed into a stack of Perceiver-style cross-attention blocks, where a set of learnable spatial queries attend to the projected video tokens as key-value pairs. Both queries and keys carry fixed 2D sinusoidal positional embeddings, enabling explicit spatial alignment without any resolution-specific learned parameters. Each frame is processed independently through the stack, confining the attention cost to the two-dimensional spatial grid while temporal modeling is handled by the preceding Conv3D and upsampler. A final LayerNorm aligns the output distribution with that of the DINOv2 tokens.
blocks.zh: 利用标准演化来实施剩余分支本身就稀释了精细的几何信息,因为它们的局部可接受领域有限。 相反,我们设计了一个高度表达式的Perceiver[15]桥模块,它利用一个学习到的按键到托盘检索,并具有全球可接受性。 视频潜伏首先通过Spatio-temporal Conv3D投射到目标特征维度中. 一个不对称的时间提升标本员然后绕过独立编码的第一帧,将子像素洗涤器应用到剩余的压缩符上,从而恢复原来的时间分辨率,从而使输出长度与原来的视频完全匹配. 上标的代币被传递到一个堆叠的Perceiver风格的交叉意向块中,其中一组可学习的空间查询作为密钥值对来关注预测的视频代币. 查询和密钥都搭载了固定的2D sinusoidal位置嵌入器,使得没有特定分辨率的学习参数的清晰空间对齐成为可能. 每个帧都通过堆栈独立处理,将注意力成本限制在二维空间网格上,而时间模型则由之前的Conv3D和 upsampler处理. 最后的LayerNorm将输出分布与DINOv2令牌的输出分布相协调.

blocks.en: The adapter output Z Z is integrated into the DINOv2 backbone at layer ℓ \ell by bypassing the patch embedding and the initial ℓ \ell transformer blocks, utilizing Z Z as the input tokens for the remaining blocks. Notably, these subsequent DINOv2 transformer blocks are fused into the 4DRM as part of the learnable spatio-temporal ViT. The selection of ℓ \ell requires a careful trade-off: integrating the features too early imposes an excessive optimization burden on the adapter, whereas a late integration sacrifices essential geometric features relied upon by the downstream heads. Therefore, we set ℓ \ell to the shallowest layer where the linear branch yields a reliable initialization. This strategy maximizes the number of retained upper blocks, effectively incorporating DINOv2’s geometric knowledge into the 4DRM.
blocks.zh: 适配器输出的Z Z通过绕过补丁嵌入和初始的l\ell变压器块,以Z Z作为剩余块的输入符号,在l\ell层整合到DINOv2主干线中. 值得注意的是,这些之后的DINOv2变压器块被熔化到4DRM中,作为可学习的Spatio-时空VIT的一部分. 选择 l\ell 需要谨慎的权衡: 过早整合这些特征会给适配器带来过度的优化负担,而后期整合则会牺牲下游头所依赖的基本几何特征. 因此,我们把I \ 放在最浅的层 线性分支产生可靠的初始化。 这一策略将保留上方块的数量最大化,有效地将DINOv2的几何知识纳入4DRM.

blocks.en: We train the student 4DRM and the domain adapter with both distillation losses and end-to-end rendering supervisions. The full training procedure is detailed in Sec. 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们训练学生 4DRM 和域适配器 兼有蒸馏损失和端到端渲染监督。 完整的培训程序详见第3.4节。

blocks.en: 3.4 Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训战略

blocks.en: We adopt a multi-stage pipeline that first builds a strong reconstructive backbone and then bridges the generative video latent space through generative distillation and end-to-end rendering refinement.
blocks.zh: 我们采用一个多阶段的管道,首先建立一个强大的重建骨干,然后通过基因蒸馏和端到端渲染精细化来连接基因影像潜伏空间。

blocks.en: Stage 1: Reconstruction Model Training. The 4DRM learns to map monocular video to 4D Gaussian primitives through large-scale training on posed videos. From each training clip of T T frames, we select K K frames as network input and predict a unified set of 4D Gaussians. These Gaussians are rendered back to all T T frames via the differentiable rasterizer, yielding dense photometric supervision that extends well beyond the temporal coverage of the input. Our objective consists of three complementary terms that respectively enforce appearance fidelity, geometric grounding, and dynamic disentanglement.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:重建模式培训。 4DRM通过对摆放的视频进行大规模训练,学习将单视视频映射到4D高斯原始人身上. 从 T T 帧的每个训练剪辑中,我们选择 K 帧作为网络输入,并预测一套统一的4D Gaussians. 这些高斯人通过可分化的光栅来制回所有的T T框架,产生密集的光度监督,远远超出输入的时间范围. 我们的目标由三个互补的术语组成,分别是加强外表的忠诚、几何定位和动态的分散。

blocks.en: Appearance fidelity. The training objective drives the student to reproduce the teacher’s 4DGS world reconstruction in a generative manner from the video latents. blocks.en: 4D Gaussian attribute alignment. ℒ 4DGS \mathcal{L}_{\text{4DGS}} applies a weighted L1 loss between the per-primitive attributes predicted by the teacher and the student, covering spatial position, anisotropic scale, rotation, opacity, color, velocity, and lifespan. This term provides the most direct form of knowledge transfer by enforcing primitive-level correspondence in attribute space.

blocks.en: Dense geometric alignment. Attribute-space supervision alone is insufficient since distinct sets of Gaussian attributes can produce visually equivalent renderings, while small attribute deviations may cause large visual discrepancies. To address this ambiguity, ℒ geom \mathcal{L}_{\text{geom}} supervises the per-view dense geometric predictions from the student 4DRM heads, combining a robust log-depth regression loss, a multi-scale depth gradient term for boundary sharpness, and an L1 penalty on predicted camera parameters. The attribute loss effectively instills the teacher’s 4D reconstruction capabilities into the student, while the geometric and feature losses simultaneously drive domain adaptation by forcing the adapter to project the video latent space onto the reconstructive 4D latent space.

blocks.en: Stage 3: End-to-End Rendering Refinement. Distillation losses operate in attribute and feature space and do not directly reflect final rendering quality. We therefore fine-tune the domain adapter and student 4DRM with an end-to-end rendering loss, where pseudo ground-truth frames are obtained by decoding z video z_{\mathrm{video}} through the frozen VAE decoder and compared against the rasterized 4DGS output using the same appearance objective as Stage 1. Gradients flow through the differentiable rasterizer into the full pipeline, so the student is optimized for rendering quality directly rather than only imitating the teacher. A linearly decayed distillation regularizer preserves the geometric structure acquired in Stage 2.

blocks.en: 4.1 4D Generation
blocks.zh: 4.1 4D 生成

blocks.en: We evaluate AEON against 4DNex [ 7 ] and Lyra [ 3 ] for 4D generation. Unlike 4DNex (per-frame point clouds) and Lyra (per-frame 3DGS), AEON predicts a unified 4DGS representation for real-time exploration. We evaluate on 30 scenes, each specified by an image-text prompt. Evaluation videos, rendered along shared camera trajectories from identical image-text prompts, are assessed via VBench [ 13 ] metrics: I2V Subject, Subject Consistency, Motion Smoothness, and Aesthetic Quality. As shown in Table 2 , AEON outperforms all baselines. While per-frame reconstruction lacks cross-frame coherence, AEON models scenes via persistent 4D Gaussians with explicit velocity and duration, naturally ensuring temporal consistency. Additionally, AEON generalizes across backbones (Wan 2.1 and Wan 2.2) without architectural modifications, yielding consistently strong results.

blocks.en: We evaluate AEON for 4D reconstruction on Dycheck [ 9 ] and DaVis [ 30 ] against SOTA baselines: L4GM [ 31 ] , 4DGT [ 48 ] , MoVies [ 22 ] , NeoVerse [ 50 ] , and StreamSplat [ 46 ] . Unlike 4DGT and MoVies, which rely on external poses (from GT or π 3 \pi^{3} [ 42 ] ), AEON’s integrated camera head jointly predicts camera parameters and 4DGS attributes from monocular RGB. StreamSplat additionally requires monocular depth from Depth Anything V2 [ 49 ] , which AEON does not need. For Dycheck’s novel view synthesis, we assess our video-to-4DGS pipeline by encoding input video into the VAE latent space and decoding it via the domain adapter and student reconstruction model.

StreamSplatz 额外要求从深度 Anything V2 [49] 得到单极深度,而AEON 并不需要. Dycheck的新观点综合,我们通过将输入视频编码到VAE潜伏空间,并通过域适配器和学生重建模型,来评估我们的视频到4DGS管道。

Despite operating through the video VAE latent bottleneck, AEON’s domain adapter effectively preserves the geometric details necessary for high-fidelity reconstruction, with especially pronounced gains on complex DaVis sequences. Furthermore, AEON needs neither camera poses nor depth at inference, and only Stage 1 uses annotated videos, so the later training stages can scale to raw videos. blocks.en: We collect 30 in-the-wild videos unseen during training and render each scene along several novel camera trajectories. We compare against TrajectoryCrafter [ 54 ] , RecamMaster [ 4 ] , and NeoVerse [ 50 ] , reporting six VBench [ 13 ] metrics in Table 4 . AEON achieves the best scores on four out of six metrics while remaining competitive on the other two. Since rendering a new trajectory from 4DGS is geometrically exact rasterization rather than learned hallucination, AEON naturally maintains strong consistency and visual quality across viewpoint changes.

blocks.en: We ablate three key design choices of AEON under the Dycheck and DaVis benchmarks in Table 5 . Conv3D projection replaces the full dual-path domain adapter with a single Conv3D layer, showing that the expressive Perceiver Bridge branch is essential for capturing the complex mapping between the two latent spaces. W/o Distill removes the distillation losses and trains the adapter with rendering supervision alone, resulting in a significant performance drop, especially on DaVis, which highlights the importance of the teacher 4DRM as a geometric foundation. W/o Duration disables the temporal opacity evolution of 4DGS, forcing all primitives to remain visible throughout the sequence; the degradation shows that explicit duration modeling of 4DGS representation is critical for handling transient dynamics. The full model combines all components and achieves the best performance on every metric.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present AEON, a unified world modeling framework that bridges video-based and 3D-based paradigms and combines the benefits of both. The core of AEON is a generative model that operates within the latent space of a pretrained video diffusion model while producing explicit 4D Gaussian Splatting as the world representation. We train a 4DRM for robust geometric guidance and design a domain adapter that translates generative video latents into the reconstructive 4D latents through end-to-end distillation. Experiments across 4D generation, dynamic-scene reconstruction, and novel trajectory rendering demonstrate that AEON achieves state-of-the-art performance while supporting a broad spectrum of world modeling applications within a single unified framework.
blocks.zh: 我们提出AEON,是一个统一的世界建模框架,将基于视频和基于3D的范式连接起来,并结合两者的利益. AEON的核心是一个基因模型,在预先训练的视频传播模型的潜在空间内运作,同时产生明确的4D高斯镀板作为世界代表. 我们训练一个4DRM来进行强几何引导,并设计一个域适配器,通过端到端的蒸馏将基因视频潜伏转化为重建的4D潜伏. 跨越4D代的实验,动态场景重建,以及新颖的轨迹渲染显示,AEON在支持在一个单一的统一框架内广泛进行世界建模应用的同时,实现了最先进的性能.

blocks.en: The temporal extent of generated 4D scenes is currently bounded by the video diffusion model’s sequence length. Because AEON stores the world as a persistent 4DGS rather than as frames, it offers a natural path beyond this window: render conditioning frames from the current 4DGS at the latest camera pose, generate the next window, decode it into new primitives, and fuse them with the existing world where they overlap. Since each step is anchored to explicit geometry rather than extrapolated from previous frames, drift should accumulate more slowly than in video-only autoregression. In addition, regions never observed in the generated video cannot be recovered, so very large viewpoint changes may reveal holes that a generative completion module could fill.
blocks.zh: 生成的4D场景的时间范围目前以视频传播模型的序列长度为界. 由于AEON将世界存储为恒定的4DGS而不是帧,它提供了这个窗口以外的自然路径:在最新的相机姿势下将当前4DGS的调节帧制成,生成下一个窗口,解码为新的原始人,并将它们与它们重叠的现有世界融为一体. 由于每一步都固定在明显的几何上,而不是从以前的帧中推断出来,漂移的积累速度应该比仅用视频自动递减的速度要慢. 此外,在生成的视频中从未观察到的区域无法恢复,因此非常大的视角变化可能揭示出一个基因完成模块可以填补的漏洞.

blocks.en:
The 4DRM encoder is built on DINOv2-Large [ 27 ] with 24 transformer blocks of dimension 1024. The 4DRM is initialized from the pretrained MapAnything weights [ 17 ] .
The domain adapter is injected at layer ℓ = 4 \ell{=}4 , retaining the upper 20 pretrained transformer blocks as a geometric foundation for the 4DRM.
The Linear branch projects the 16-channel Wan video latent to 1024 channels, initialized via closed-form ridge regression against the fourth-layer DINOv2 activations. The Perceiver Bridge employs 4 cross-attention blocks with 16 heads and 1024 learnable queries, and a temporal interleave of factor 4 inverts the video VAE’s temporal compression. All three stages are optimized with AdamW using a weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a cosine schedule with 2 000 linear warmup steps, a base learning rate of 5 × 10 − 6 5{\times}10^{-6} , and gradient clipping at a global norm of 1.0.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , AEON synthesizes high-quality 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) environments from text or image prompts. This is achieved by first generating video latents using Wan-DiT conditioned on the input prompts. These latents are subsequently translated into 4D spatial-temporal latents and decoded to reconstruct the final 4DGS world.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,AEON从文本或图像提示中合成高质量的4D高斯镀(4DGS)环境. 这是通过首先使用Wan-DIT以输入提示为条件生成视频潜伏实现的. 这些潜伏物随后被翻译成4D空间时空潜伏物并解码以重建最终的4DGS世界.

blocks.en: For video-to-world reconstruction, input videos are encoded into video latents using Wan-VAE. These latents are then processed to generate 4DGS scenes, following the same pipeline as our text/image-to-world generation.
blocks.zh: 对于视频到世界重建,输入视频使用Wan-VAE编码成视频潜伏. 然后对这些潜伏物进行处理,以产生4DGS场景,遵循与我们文字/图像到世界一代相同的管道。

blocks.en: The generated 4DGS representations inherently support real-time novel view synthesis across arbitrary viewpoints and timesteps.
blocks.zh: 生成的4DGS表示在本质上支持跨任意观点和时序的实时新观点综合.

blocks.en: The generated 4DGS encapsulates rich geometric and physical properties, which can be directly extracted to derive depth maps, normal maps, motion masks, and optical flow. Specifically, motion masks are obtained by filtering the lifespans of the Gaussians, as dynamic elements typically correspond to Gaussians with shorter lifespans.
blocks.zh: 生成的4DGS封装了丰富的几何和物理属性,可以直接提取以得出深度地图,普通地图,运动面具,以及光学流. 具体地说,运动口罩是通过过滤高斯人的寿命来获得的,因为动态元素通常与寿命较短的高斯人对应.

blocks.en: Beyond dynamic scene generation, AEON is also highly effective for static 3D world generation. An example of this capability is provided in the third row of Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 在动态场景生成之外,AEON对静态3D世界生成也非常有效. 图1第三行提供了这种能力的例子。

blocks.en: Because AEON generates explicit 4D representations, it inherently facilitates seamless scene editing and structural decomposition for downstream simulations (shown in the bottom row of Fig. 1 ). By leveraging the motion masks derived from Gaussian lifespan filtering, we can cleanly separate a generated scene into its static and dynamic components. These isolated parts from various generated 4DGS worlds can then be freely recomposed to simulate novel scenarios. The same explicit structure is what embodied simulation needs. The metric geometry of the static component can supply occupancy and free space for an agent, the dynamic primitives move according to their own velocities, and real-time rasterization renders egocentric observations at every step. An agent can therefore be placed in a generated world, roll out its actions, and receive rendered observations in a closed loop, and because the world is persistent, the same scenario can be replayed for repeatable evaluation.
blocks.zh: 由于AEON产生明显的4D表示,因此它本质上有利于无缝场景编辑和结构分解,用于下游模拟(shown in the bottom for Fig. 1 . 通过利用高斯寿命过滤产生的运动口罩,我们可以将生成的场景清洁地分离成其静态和动态组件. 这些来自各种生成的4DGS世界的孤立部分,然后可以自由重新组合来模拟新奇情景. 同样的明确结构是包含模拟需求的内容。 静态元件的度量几何可以供给一种剂的占用和空闲空间,动态原始体按照自身速度移动,实时光栅化使每个步骤的自我中心观测. 因此,一个代理人可以被放置在一个生成的世界中,推出其行动,并以封闭的循环接收所给出的观测结果,而且由于世界是持续的,同样的情景可以重现,重复评价.

blocks.en: For 4D generation and novel trajectory rendering we adopt six metrics from the VBench [ 13 ] benchmark, each targeting a distinct aspect of video quality. I2V Subject measures the visual fidelity between the conditioning image and the generated subject, quantifying how faithfully the output preserves the identity of the input. Subject Consistency evaluates the temporal coherence of the foreground subject across frames by computing pairwise feature similarity over the video. Background Consistency similarly measures the stability of background regions to detect unwanted scene drift. Temporal Flickering captures high-frequency luminance and color variations between consecutive frames, where higher scores correspond to smoother transitions. Motion Smoothness assesses whether object trajectories follow physically plausible paths without abrupt jumps. Aesthetic Quality and Imaging Quality respectively evaluate the overall visual appeal and the low-level image attributes such as sharpness and color fidelity. All VBench metrics are reported on a scale where higher values indicate better performance.
blocks.zh: 对于4D生成和新颖的轨迹渲染,我们采用V Bench [13] 基准中的6个度量,每个度量针对视频质量的一个不同方面. I2V主题测量了调制图像和生成主体之间的视觉忠诚度,量化了输出如何忠实地保存输入特性. 主题一致性通过计算成对地特征与视频的相似性来评价前景主体跨帧的时间一致性. 背景一致性类似地测量背景区域的稳定性,以检测意外的场景漂移。 Temperal Flickering捕捉连续帧之间的高频亮度和颜色变化,其中较高的分数对应更平滑的过渡. 动议 平滑度评估物体轨迹是否遵循物理上可行的路径而不突然跳跃. 审美质量和成像质量分别评价整体视觉吸引力和锐度和色彩忠诚度等低级图像属性. 所有V Bench 度量衡均按较高数值表明性能较好的尺度报告。
